solutions.title: Level-order last node
solutions.strategy: Traverse by levels and keep the last node value from each level.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The queue and result can together grow linearly in the number of nodes.

solutions.title: Right-first DFS
solutions.strategy: Visit right children before left children and record the first value at each depth.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The recursion stack grows with height h, while the result stores one value per depth.
